## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and the behavior after this change. Link a related issue when available.

## Validation

List the exact commands and results relevant to this change. Include skips, unavailable hardware/dependencies, and any numerical or performance comparison settings.

## Compatibility and evidence

Describe changes to input geometry, preprocessing, dependencies, checkpoint/review schemas, or outputs. State the scope of any accuracy or performance claim; CPU/mock tests do not establish accelerator or real radiomics support.

- [ ] The contribution contains no patient data, credentials, private teaching material, or unlicensed artifacts.
